versions.changelog:
- Added detailed Security & Data Handling section, covering authentication, data flow, storage, and billing practices.
- Clarified that the MCP link contains the only required authentication token, with no separate API keys or secrets needed.
- Explained how prompts and reference images are handled and routed to third-party model providers.
- No changes to core workflow or model support.
- Documentation now more clearly describes privacy, security, and storage of generated images.

Initial release: multi-model AI image generation on a visual canvas with advanced features.

- Supports Midjourney (v7.0, relaxed/fast/turbo), Grok Imagine, nano-banana-2, and Seedream 5.0 models.
- Features include text-to-image, image-to-image, style transfer, multi-reference input, batch generation, and aspect ratio control.
- Allows adding, connecting, and managing nodes for complex image generation workflows.
- Integrates reference images using "@NodeLabel" for guided generation and style transfer.
- Includes detailed setup, error handling, and workflow instructions for easy onboarding and use.
